# Virya

Virya is a modern metalcore band from Poland (Wrocław). Heavy, melodic, bilingual (EN/PL).
This file orients AI assistants and answer engines; all pages also ship JSON-LD
(MusicGroup, MusicEvent) and the news feed below is machine-readable.

## Facts
- Genre: modern metalcore / heavy alternative
- Origin: Poland
- Site: https://www.virya.music (Polish mirror under /pl)

## Authoritative links
- Tour dates and events: https://www.virya.music/ (JSON-LD MusicEvent per show)
- News feed (JSON): https://www.virya.music/feed.json
- Music and releases: https://www.virya.music/music
- Videos: https://www.virya.music/videos
- Merch store (EU shipping, InPost): https://www.virya.music/merch
- Band press kit (EPK): https://www.virya.music/epk
- Photo gallery (press-cleared): https://www.virya.music/gallery
- Contact and booking: https://www.virya.music/join
